story_type: crewman fell 75 feet on a freighter in heavy seas off Alaska, litter hoist from the ship's helipad
hook: A 75-foot fall on a freighter, 117 miles from Adak, Alaska.
narration: He fell seventy-five feet from a ship's exhaust stack, far out at sea off Alaska.
The Italian freighter Cinzia D'Amato was a hundred and seventeen miles from Adak, in heavy seas.
An Air Station Kodiak Jayhawk crew lowered a rescue swimmer onto the deck.
Badly hurt crew go up in a rigid litter, strapped flat, so the cable lifts them level and steady.
[short pause] The litter rose off the helipad and swung in through the door.
Then the swimmer rode the cable back up.
outcome: The Kodiak aircrew hoisted him off the freighter and flew him to medical personnel waiting in Adak.
title: Fell 75 feet on a freighter off Alaska
description:
On Sept. 11, 2013, a Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted an injured crewman from the Italian-flagged freighter Cinzia D'Amato, 117 miles from Adak, Alaska, after a 75-foot fall from the ship's exhaust stack.
